cases.name: switch off (the default): silent past a step, and remembers nothing
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/off-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; out=$(printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-big.jsonl", "prompt": "go on"}' | env -u HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); rc=$?; [ -e "$w/.claude/local/clear-nudge.tsv" ] && s=present || s=absent; printf 'rc=%s out=%s state=%s' "$rc" "${#out}" "$s"

cases.name: on, under the first step (50k): silent
on, past 150k: one line of context, the size of the last main-chain request in thousands, and /clear for the user to run

expect.context: clear-nudge: about 160k tokens of context are replayed on every turn (usage of the last request). If the current task is finished, tell the user at the end of your answer that `/clear` with a short brief of where things stand costs less than carrying on.

cases.name: the same step is never said twice in a session
another session past the same step is told on its own
after a compaction brings the context under the step, crossing it again speaks again
cases.cmd: n=0; for t in t-big t-small t-big; do out=$(printf '{"hook_event_name":"UserPromptSubmit","session_id":"{{SID}}","transcript_path":"{{FIX}}/%s.jsonl"}' "$t" | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); case "$out" in *clear-nudge:*) n=$((n+1)) ;; esac; done; printf 'nudges=%s' "$n"

cases.name: a subagent's turns are not the main chain: a 900k sidechain after a 50k main turn is silent
bad input - empty, {}, non-JSON, another event, no transcript, a missing transcript, no usage, an unsafe session id: exit 0, silent
cases.cmd: r=''; for x in '' '{}' 'not json' '[1]' '{"hook_event_name": "Stop", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-big.jsonl", "prompt": "go on"}' '{"hook_event_name":"UserPromptSubmit","session_id":"{{SID}}"}' '{"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/missing.jsonl", "prompt": "go on"}' '{"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-nousage.jsonl", "prompt": "go on"}' '{"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "session_id": "../../etc/x", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-big.jsonl", "prompt": "go on"}'; do out=$(printf '%s' "$x" | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP={{FIX}}/ws bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); r="$r$?:${#out} "; done; printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: plan E: inside a subagent, a PreToolUse Agent payload with agent_id reads the agent's own transcript <dir>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl - every turn of it, sidechain included - and past 150k speaks to the agent, as PreToolUse context, with the figure to report

expect.context: clear-nudge: about 170k tokens of context are replayed on every turn of this agent (usage of its last request). There is no `/clear` here: read nothing more that a role can read for you, and carry the figure into the Notes of your report (`context: >=170k`).

cases.name: plan E: the agent's line is a PreToolUse answer, and its step is remembered under <session>:<agent>, apart from the session's
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-key-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; out=$(printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Agent", "session_id": "ses-agent", "agent_id": "batchbig", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl"}' | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); ev=$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName'); printf 'event=%s state=%s' "$ev" "$(tr '\t' '=' < "$w/.claude/local/clear-nudge.tsv")"

cases.name: plan E: the same agent past the same step is not told twice; another agent of the session under the step is silent; the session's own UserPromptSubmit reading of the main transcript (50k) stays silent
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-twice-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; n=0; for a in batchbig batchbig batchsmall; do out=$(printf '{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"Agent","session_id":"ses-agent","agent_id":"%s","transcript_path":"{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl"}' "$a" | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); case "$out" in *clear-nudge:*) n=$((n+1)) ;; esac; done; out=$(printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "session_id": "ses-agent", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl", "prompt": "go on"}' | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); printf 'nudges=%s main=%s' "$n" "${#out}"

cases.name: plan E: a PreToolUse payload without agent_id (the main conversation delegating), another tool in a subagent, an unknown agent transcript, an unsafe agent id, a switch at 0: exit 0, silent
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-bad-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; r=''; for x in '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Agent", "session_id": "ses-agent", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-big.jsonl"}' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Bash", "session_id": "ses-agent", "agent_id": "batchbig", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl"}' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Agent", "session_id": "ses-agent", "agent_id": "nosuch", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl"}' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Agent", "session_id": "ses-agent", "agent_id": "../batchbig", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl"}'; do out=$(printf '%s' "$x" | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); r="$r$?:${#out} "; done; out=$(printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Agent", "session_id": "ses-agent", "agent_id": "batchbig", "transcript_path": "{{FIX}}/t-small.jsonl"}' | HARNESS_CLEAR_NUDGE=0 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/clear-nudge.sh); r="$r$?:${#out} "; [ -e "$w/.claude/local/clear-nudge.tsv" ] && s=present || s=absent; printf '%sstate=%s' "$r" "$s"

cases.name: plan E: settings.json wires clear-nudge on UserPromptSubmit and on PreToolUse for the Agent tool, nowhere else
cases.cmd: jq -r '[.hooks | to_entries[] | .key as $e | .value[] | . as $g | .hooks[] | select(.command | test("hook-run\\.sh\" clear-nudge$")) | $e + ":" + ($g.matcher // "*")] | sort | join(" ")' {{CLAUDE}}/settings.json
